verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical and share the same faults. The subtitle is squeezed into a narrow left column with one or two words per line, and its type is larger than the card copy. The featured YEARLY card has been shrunk smaller than the other two cards, which flips the original hierarchy. The legal text is illegibly tiny. A centres its CTA on the card row, which looks a little more deliberate. B top-aligns its CTA with the cards, leaving a loose gap above the floating legal text.
